exposure: dinoprostone vaginal insert (DVI) combined with mechanical cervical dilatation
outcome: DVI removal due to labor progression
pre-pregnancy body mass index (as a factor associated with DVI efficacy)
cohort: Pregnant women with poor cervical maturation (Bishop score 0-2) undergoing labor induction, including a subgroup with post-date pregnancy.
finding: The combined cervical maturation approach using DVI with a mechanical dilator significantly reduced the time of uterotonics administration, and low pre-pregnancy BMI was associated with DVI efficacy.
mod_finding: The success rate for vaginal delivery was comparable between the DVI group and the control group.
